context.transcript:
Hi, I was transferred to you by the bank's customer service desk.
I'm interested in getting a loan to do some repair work on my home.
Is that possible?
Certainly.
Our bank offers different types of financing for home improvement work.
Do you own the property?
Yes, I do.
Okay.
Then the first thing I'll need you to do is fill out a loan application so that we can check your financial history.
All right.
Can I find that form online?
Actually, no, but I'll send one to you right away.
Please fill it out and send it back to me.
Can I have your home address?
context.transcript_translation:
您好，我是银行客服转来的。
我对获得一笔贷款来在我家做一些维修工作感兴趣。
这可行吗？
当然可以。
我们银行为家居装修工作提供不同类型的融资服务。
您拥有这处房产吗？
是的，我拥有。
好的。
那么首先需要您做的是填写一份贷款申请表，这样我们才能查阅您的财务记录。
没问题。
我可以在线找到这个表格吗？
实际上不能，但我会马上给您发送一份。
请填写好并交还给我。
我可以知道您的家庭地址吗？
